name: the real look's light
about: docs/briefs/red-dead.md R1 (light with shape), DESIGN.md section 4: under the real look only, LightLooks lays night_values over the game's night (light_game.json's, which stay the painted look's) and day_values over its day, and RoomLight is on (its bounce carries the lamps' pools). The saloon at night (2026-11-04 trials, build/r1): light pass round 3's warm wash taken back (the room's fill 0.7 -> 0.18 and neutral, not the lamps' gold; the wall lamps' reach 0.7 -> 0.6, so the sconces' pools part), the grade's lifted blacks gone and light C's cool shadow tint warm (under AgX it turned the floor purple), RoomLight's bounce up (1.5 -> 2.6) and its moonlight in the door and windows down to 0.1 (it washed the floor and the bar lilac); the four lamps hung over the room shaded (RealLook: their tin shade casts a shadow, real.hung_*) and brighter and reaching the floor, a pool under each with the chairs' shadows in it and the ceiling over them dark (the saloon_hanging dials reach only the porch lantern); the lamps' haze at light C's (0.6: at 1-2.5 every sconce was a blot) in a thin room haze (0.08). The street by day keeps R0's light: haze down the street (fog x2.2, aerial perspective 0.2), SDFGI's and the sky's fill in the shade down and SSAO in the sun read as washed, flat noon to the cheap judge (round 2: road_low_noon good indie -> cheap indie), so day_values held nothing else. Judged in two tries (docs/screenshots/judge/2026-11-04_cheap_r1_saloon, _r1_real2) and a third between them (_r1_try3): the hung lamps at x2.5 energy, x1.8 reach lifted the whole room (deep shadow 24-41% -> 8-10%), so x1.4 and x1.4. The exposure (#641, Sean 2026-11-08: daytime looked worst, faces and the street washed out): R0's x1.4 is the night's (the saloon unchanged); by day x1.05, for the whole scene (no face's own exposure, no skin darkened), blended by the sun as every dial here is (night_share: x1.05 from an hour after sunrise to an hour before sunset, ~x1.13 at golden hour 17.6, ~x1.26 at 18.0, x1.4 from 18.5). So day_values is no longer empty: the street's haze and shade are still R0's.
